name: inventory
notes: Owns stores, the append-only stock ledger (inv_ledger, with a trigger that refuses update and delete), balances, transfers, counts and reorder levels. Company stock is valued by calling valuation inside the same transaction; client-owned stock carries no cost and never posts a cost entry. A transfer takes the stock out of the source when sent and valuation moves the cost (recordTransfer) when it is received, so in-transit stock is out of both stores. An issue posts one project cost entry at the valuation value; a return reverses that entry and re-posts the remainder. H-21 default used: salvage value zero (setting inventory.salvage_value_mode). Counts need the setting inventory.stock_loss_cost_code (H-25) before they can be submitted. The nullable mst_items.default_cost_code_id is added by the masterdata module (migration 0014), not by inventory.
